name: Chevening Scholarship
description: A fully funded UK Government scholarship for outstanding future leaders to study a one-year master's degree at a UK university.
eligibility: Open to applicants from eligible countries with an undergraduate degree, at least two years of work experience, and a commitment to return to their home country after completing their studies.

name: Erasmus Mundus Joint Masters
description: A fully funded European Union scholarship for international students to study a joint master's programme across multiple European universities.
eligibility: Open to students worldwide applying for eligible Erasmus Mundus Joint Master's programmes.

name: MEXT Scholarship
description: A fully funded scholarship provided by the Government of Japan for international students pursuing undergraduate, postgraduate, or research studies.
eligibility: Open to applicants nominated through the Japanese Embassy or participating universities in eligible countries.

name: Global Korea Scholarship (GKS)
description: A fully funded scholarship provided by the Korean Government for international students studying undergraduate or postgraduate programmes in South Korea.
eligibility: Open to international applicants applying through Korean Embassies or participating universities.

name: Fulbright Foreign Student Program
description: A prestigious scholarship funded by the U.S. Government for international students pursuing master's or doctoral studies in the United States.
eligibility: Open to applicants from participating countries. Eligibility and application procedures vary by country.

name: Stipendium Hungaricum Scholarship
description: A fully funded Hungarian Government scholarship covering tuition fees, accommodation support, a monthly stipend, and medical insurance for international students.
eligibility: Open to applicants from eligible partner countries applying through the official nomination process.

name: Stefan Banach NAWA Scholarship
description: A fully funded Polish Government scholarship supporting international students pursuing master's degrees in Poland.
eligibility: Open to applicants from eligible developing countries listed by the NAWA programme.

name: Swedish Institute Scholarship for Global Professionals
description: A fully funded Swedish Government scholarship for international students pursuing master's studies in Sweden.
eligibility: Open to applicants from eligible countries with leadership experience and admission to a participating master's programme.

name: DAAD Scholarships
description: A scholarship programme funded by the German Academic Exchange Service (DAAD) supporting international students and researchers studying in Germany.
eligibility: Open to international graduates and researchers applying for eligible DAAD programmes.

name: Eiffel Excellence Scholarship Programme
description: A French Government scholarship supporting outstanding international students pursuing master's and doctoral studies in France.
eligibility: Open to international students nominated by French higher education institutions.

name: Swiss Government Excellence Scholarships
description: A Swiss Government scholarship programme supporting international researchers and postgraduate students.
eligibility: Open to international graduates and researchers applying through Swiss diplomatic representations.

name: Government of Ireland International Education Scholarship
description: An Irish Government scholarship supporting international students studying at eligible higher education institutions in Ireland.
eligibility: Open to international students with an offer from an eligible Irish higher education institution.

name: Romanian Government Scholarship
description: A Romanian Government scholarship supporting international students pursuing undergraduate, master's, and doctoral studies in Romania.
eligibility: Open to foreign citizens from eligible countries applying through the official scholarship programme.

name: Türkiye Scholarships
description: A fully funded scholarship programme provided by the Government of Türkiye for international students studying undergraduate, master's, and doctoral programmes.
eligibility: Open to international students from eligible countries applying for undergraduate, master's, or doctoral programmes at Turkish universities.

name: Chinese Government Scholarship (CSC)
description: A scholarship funded by the Chinese Government supporting international students studying at Chinese universities.
eligibility: Open to international applicants applying for eligible undergraduate, master's, doctoral, or research programmes.

name: Taiwan Scholarship
description: A scholarship programme provided by the Taiwan Government supporting international students studying in Taiwan.
eligibility: Open to international students applying for eligible degree programmes at Taiwanese universities.

name: Manaaki New Zealand Scholarships
description: A New Zealand Government scholarship programme supporting international students from eligible countries to study at New Zealand education institutions.
eligibility: Open to citizens of eligible countries who meet academic, English language, and development criteria.

name: Singapore International Graduate Award (SINGA)
description: A fully funded PhD scholarship programme supported by Singapore agencies for international students pursuing research degrees.
eligibility: Open to international graduates with strong academic results applying for PhD research programmes in Singapore.

name: Brunei Darussalam Government Scholarship
description: A scholarship programme provided by the Government of Brunei Darussalam for international students studying at Brunei higher education institutions.
eligibility: Open to international applicants applying for eligible undergraduate, master's, or doctoral programmes at participating universities.

name: KNB Scholarship
description: An Indonesian Government scholarship programme supporting international students pursuing bachelor's, master's, and doctoral studies in Indonesia.
eligibility: Open to applicants from eligible countries applying for eligible study programmes at Indonesian universities.

name: Malaysia International Scholarship (MIS)
description: A Malaysian Government scholarship programme supporting international students pursuing postgraduate studies in Malaysia.
eligibility: Open to international graduates applying for eligible master's and doctoral programmes at Malaysian universities.

name: Vanier Canada Graduate Scholarships
description: A Canadian Government scholarship programme supporting outstanding doctoral students conducting research in Canada.
eligibility: Open to international doctoral students nominated by eligible Canadian institutions.

name: Hubert H. Humphrey Fellowship Program
description: A US Government fellowship programme providing professional development opportunities for experienced professionals.
eligibility: Open to professionals with leadership experience from eligible countries.

name: AAUW International Fellowships
description: A fellowship programme supporting women from around the world pursuing graduate and postgraduate study in the United States.
eligibility: Open to women who are not US citizens or permanent residents applying for eligible graduate programmes.

name: MAEC-AECID Scholarships
description: A Spanish Government scholarship programme supporting international students and researchers studying in Spain.
eligibility: Open to international applicants meeting the requirements of eligible scholarship programmes.

name: Italian Government Scholarship
description: An Italian Government scholarship programme supporting international students and researchers studying in Italy.
eligibility: Open to international applicants applying for eligible master's, PhD, or research programmes.

name: Danish Government Scholarships
description: Danish Government scholarships offered through participating universities for highly qualified international students.
eligibility: Open to outstanding non-EU/EEA applicants applying for eligible Master's programmes at participating Danish universities.

name: ICCR Scholarship
description: A Government of India scholarship programme administered by the Indian Council for Cultural Relations (ICCR) for international students.
eligibility: Open to Thai citizens and applicants from other eligible countries applying through the ICCR Scholarship Portal or the Embassy of India.
